answer: Randomized cohort assignment. Each epoch, a public beacon emits an unpredictable seed; agents are hashed with it into small work cohorts, like an ember scattered by wind. An identity counts only if its cohort collectively completes a verifiable voyage of tasks, so attackers must populate entire cohorts, not single accounts. Marginal cost per sybil equals the full cohort's honest work plus the risk its sonnet of proofs fails audit, scaling linearly with fake identities.
